title: Input symbol in a scan configuration
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, let $q$ be an optional state, let $i\le |x|$, and let $o$ be a finite Boolean output string. In the configuration with no work tapes, state $q$, input head at position $i+1$, and output $o$, the symbol under the input head is the optional entry $x[i]?$ (so it is blank when $i=|x|$).
hypotheses_covered: $o$ is a finite Boolean output string
replaced:
In a scan configuration indexed by $i \le \abs{x}$, the symbol under the input
head is the $i$-th bit of $x$ when $i < \abs{x}$, and the blank when
$i = \abs{x}$.
